title: Authority, access and acquisition
wording: Use the complete native classAccess row, actual acquired repertoire/preparation and actual provider. All five identities are rank7/base17RP, Action,120feet,V/S/F; do not replace these with foreign spell rules. Simulacrum is one identity with both native placements: Bard/Mirrorsage/Wizard use Illusion, Cleric/Mage use Universal. The other four use their actual Universal rows. Bard/Mirrorsage minimum19 is rank eligibility, not proof of an actual level19 repertoire addition. A positive class19 fixture needs a real acquisition provider; the actual hybrid addition can instead occur at20. None of the five grants an RP pool or a class by being named in a book. Caster class-level scaling, spell attack, DC, discounts, automatic features and owned ledgers are actual-source inputs. The Wizard13 teaching build below uses PB5/INT+4, DC17 and attack+9 outside its chosen Illusion school; School Mastery makes Illusion DC19/attack+11, not DC18. First distinct prepared matrix grants zero BASE strain, not a free casting, and never extends to Cast Echo's temporarily authorized child. No rank9 payload is declared operative by its name alone. All native source objects, old null flags, original decisions and prior reports remain historical bytes; this proposal adds a selected layer, not an index or runtime promotion.

title: Paid casting, cadence and ordinary Ready
wording: Validate observable acquisition, components, action opportunity, actual targets/range/path and quoted costs before commitment; unknown eligibility is not a free hidden-state diagnostic. Pay the actual Action/RP/other costs and book real Dissonance/history before interruption. A countered, saved-against, missed or late-prevented cast refunds nothing. Rank costs0..9 are0/2/3/5/7/10/13/17/21/26. Ordinary base strain is0/1/2 for rank0/1..5/6..9, plus actual Refrain; actual source exceptions remain. Limit=max(4,2+PB+max(0,casting modifier)); surcharge applies to the actual precommit D at Limit,Limit+3,Limit+6. No generic overcast, resource conversion, upcast or auto scaling is added. Use one real concentration ledger: beginning another concentration obligation ends the incompatible old one at commitment, even if countered. Ordinary Ready pays and casts at preparation with its one counter window, holds concentration, ends no later than next own regular START, completes the perceived trigger first, then spends the actual Reaction to release with current targets/geometry. No second ordinary casting/payment/counter/history occurs. Only Cast Echo's expressly new child-commit and Reaction-checkpoint clauses below are exceptions. COPY-READY-ALLOWANCE-02 remains a separate feat-only preparation-allowance policy; it is not a charge or permission for these five ordinary spells. The existing class configuration loses1 Dissonance on an actual regular turn without a spell or magical class ability; Refrain does not reset on idle turns. Continuous actual long-cast work is casting activity, not an idle turn. Do not report frozen positive Dissonance through a long sequence of genuinely idle regular turns.

title: Actual bodies, rolls and consequences
wording: Targets and placed bodies retain actual whole-body geometry, supports, plane/environment, custody, weight and Load. No point through opaque total cover supplies perception or line of effect. A teleport, absent body or size alteration needs its actual source permission; visual images do not become creatures. Attacks use actual AC and natural1/20 attack rules. Saves are total versus DC without natural-die task shifts. Ability-check counter/examination uses the actual task degrees/natural shifts followed by its specified binary collapse. Fresh payload RNG is not a donor's stored roll or a new Fate presentation. Damage follows the source's real save/type defenses, flat-reduction rules, buffers, normal HP, Wounds, life and concentration processing. Damage roots retain the actual dealer and source-specific creation-time Null state; Cast Echo creates a new child, not the donor's root. A finite creature's explicit NullDisabled exception cannot be generalized to living targets or different summons. Zero HP is not automatically actual death. Keep support/Falling and existing injuries, Wounds and independent conditions through invisibility, masking, suspension and copying. A paid effect does not repair unknown content or invent a monster CR or opposed-check modifier.

title: Clock, suppression and removal
wording: Use actual registered regular/virtual markers and absolute deadlines; extra turns do not refresh round allowances or regular-start recharge, and no overdue event is replayed by initiative changes. Incapacitated ends applicable concentration. Suppression is expression-specific and normally does not stop source clocks; dispel/removal is not the same event. Greater Dispel and Lesser Antimagic use their complete actual accepted ranks, areas, paths, timing and persistence, not a generic delete-all rule. The four specifically authored persistent applications below state their own local behavior: Meta Surge stops new waivers while suppressed; Erase removes only the affected protection/memory expression temporarily; Sequester's suspension suppression wakes permanently; Simulacrum full suppression preserves one absent body rather than recreating it. This does not rewrite the differing Companion05 or Illusion13 lifecycles. Existing completed damage/healing/work/memory edits are not rolled back. Due expiry is processed before a new simultaneous voluntary commitment. Source-owned tokens and consumed histories survive resumption, recast and serialization.

title: No hidden fact, identity or resource substitution
wording: A source's private event, memory or profile record is not a public oracle. No player/controller receives hidden names, HP, allegiance, memories, source IDs or failure-reason diagnostics merely from a paid attempt. A copied memory is no truer than the original accessible belief, and a copied body is not the original entity, its owner, soul, citizen identity or credential. Source-created replica props and derivative bodies supply no loot, XP, corpse fuel, crafting material, soul, resource-on-kill or duplicated historical entitlement. Their expressly paid intrinsic spell effects and actual separately obtained equipment keep their stated scopes; this boundary does not cancel Soulburn's settled intrinsic output through a genuinely acquired Grand Reservoir use. Lawful creature consent and knowledge are actual operands, not made true by a spell-selection UI. Unknown or missing native profiles remain particular content prerequisites and not invented templates. There is no sixth DE4 output channel, new setting plane, afterlife or Heartcell interpretation.
